integrity: Complete self-contained proof and diagnostic script; finite tests are not an infinite theorem or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for critical scalar linear additive-noise delay dynamics with zero history; applies componentwise to isotropic vectors, not to nonlinear Gaussian feedback over arbitrary times. Pointwise L2 rate; weak continuous-path convergence. Historical priority and any general renewal-theorem implication remain independently unverified.
title: Critical cubic dispersion and an exact covariance envelope for repulsive delayed diffusion
